description: Windows GUI for managing software updates and system utilities through WinGet.
pre_install: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $payload -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Wingetix application payload archive was not found in the NSIS package.' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $mainExe -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Wingetix.exe was not found after extracting the nested application archive.' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $appAsar -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'resources\app.asar was not found after extracting the nested application archive.' }
notes: Scoop extracts the official NSIS package and its embedded app-64.7z payload; the vendor installer is not executed. Wingetix requests administrator rights when launched and requires WinGet/App Installer to be available. The upstream LICENSE file is GPL-3.0 while package.json declares MIT, so the manifest license is Unknown pending upstream clarification.
